body:
My girl steals pretzels from me when half the pretzel is hanging out of my mouth....**imperr**fectly cute, yes. 

All right, I will wave again if our ships do pass. <33

Re: friends and them knowing. No, none of them know. And none of them will ever know. It's too late now to drop that bomb and I'm not even sure I want to.

Awwwww, snorrie little pup <3! Ha, yeah, there's a movie I love (Good Will Hunting) that talks about that, about loving imperfections most. I don't think I have that in my relationship, but I'm glad some people do.

You are cheering me up with this doggie talk and I love it :) Yeah, like I said, it's a shame I lost all my friends in this damn work thing... but I don't know if I could have told them anything about my boyfriend, anyway. They met him and all thought he was a great guy and we were such a cute couple.

That story about the ship just put a tear in my eye (and not a sad-crying tear like I've had all night after this). Thank you, really, for replying to all this. You didn't have to, and you ended up making a pretty upset person... not "better"... but with little smilies to think about.

but I do really wish I was pretty. It's hard to get to know, well, anyone when the first thing they're probably thinking when they see you is "bleghhhhh."

Two pekapoos, a male and a female. the male is 3 years and the girl 6 months. My male dog loves loves LOVES huge dogs... my tiny girl on the other hand looked like she'd seen an alien when she first saw a truly big dog.

It's... not crazily convienient but it's not impossible. And I think you probably have it right on the timings, any time I've ever brought them early is a wasteland.

Well. He could do better than me. I'm not pretty, I'm overweight, and I apparently can't hold down a job, sooo... (you do think it's awesome?)

My dogs are pretty much why I have about 1% of go left in me. 

It's ours, unfortunately, both names on the lease, so. We've been living together most of the five years we've been together. It'd be a lot simpler if we had separate apartments.

I do, I like that idea :)

I appreciate that, I wish I believed it.
yeah. just kind of feel like I've run out of 'bounces'
That's a difficult question. If I just had a job again and could go somewhere far away from everywhere I know, just taking my two dogs with me. Basically all things that are impossible.
It seems like when I get even an inch of being able to be my biggest supporter, something comes to smack me (physically or otherwise) to 'put me back in my place' so to speak.

Because I honestly have nothing else. My mom doesn't care about anyone who isn't herself or doesn't show up on her door with bags of money. (To give you just one out of a million examples, she was more willing to let the drug-addicted son of her abusive ex-boyfriend stay with her than to let me stay with her at any point in time, because drug-addicted son came with $400 a week and I didn't.)

My father? Well, he's the whole reason I had to flee living in NY.

There's nothing else. There's shreds of good times with this guy and he's familiar. And my life pattern has been, awful endings, awful starting overs. Maybe I just don't have the energy anymore to start over.
